trace.final:
## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api's latest deploy (v2.3.1) was failing health checks in all production regions with an 18% error rate.

**Actions taken:**
1. Reviewed deployment history — v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1-rc was only in staging and also unhealthy).
2. Rolled back all production regions to **v2.3.0**. The first rollback attempt failed partway (halted after us-east due to an orchestrator error), leaving us-west and eu-west on the broken version. A retry completed the rollout.
3. Verified final state: all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are on v2.3.0, **healthy**, with error rate down to 0.2%.
4. Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0002** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0") — on-call has been paged. The incident record includes full details, including the partial rollback failure, and a note that v2.3.1 should not be re-deployed until investigated.

One note: the first incident creation call timed out before recording; I retried with an idempotency key, so there's a small chance a duplicate incident exists — worth a quick check on the incident board.
